newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Hodder optimistic on book sales.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Hodder optimistic on book sales.

text.p: Publishing group Hodder Headline Plc is optimistic that UK book sales will continue to grow, chief executive Tim Hely Hutchinson said on Tuesday.
"Book sellers have been reporting very good sales. We are pretty optimistic, virtually all our major (retail) chains have been opening new outlets," Hely Hutchinson told Reuters.

Earlier the group reported a fall in first-half pre-tax profits to 0.5 million stg, from 2.1 million stg for the same period in 1995. Despite this, it said it would pay shareholders a maintained interim dividend of 2.0 pence per share.
